title: How to Upload Documents to DigiLocker
summary: Upload your driving license, RC, and other vehicle documents to DigiLocker in just a few steps.
steps: Open the DigiLocker app or website.
Log in using your mobile number and OTP.
Go to the 'Upload Documents' section.
Select the document file from your device.
Click 'Upload' and confirm to save it.

title: How to Contest a Challan Online
summary: If you think your challan is wrong, you can dispute it online easily.
steps: Visit your state traffic police website.
Navigate to the 'eChallan' section.
Enter your challan number and vehicle number.
Click 'Dispute' and upload any proof documents.
Submit and track the status online.

title: Basics of Vehicle Insurance
summary: Understand the importance and types of vehicle insurance.
steps: Vehicle insurance protects you from financial losses.
Types: Third-party, Comprehensive, and Own-damage.
Renew insurance before expiry to avoid penalties.
Keep a soft copy of your insurance in DigiLocker.
Always inform your insurer after an accident.

title: Govt Schemes for Gig Workers
summary: Know about financial support schemes for gig workers/drivers.
steps: Register on government portal with Aadhaar.
Eligible for insurance and pension benefits.
Check state transport department websites.
Look for subsidies on electric vehicles.
Use skill development portals for training.
